tasks.label: Restart ComfyCrawler Server
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'server\.py' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Start-Process -FilePath python -ArgumentList 'server.py' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' -WindowStyle Normal
